body.name: ghat
body.def: Let \(\underline c_X\) and \(\overline c_X\) be the minimum and maximum of the \(c_X\)-projection of \(\mathcal K_{\mathrm{nuis}}\), and define \(\underline c_W,\overline c_W\) analogously. With \(\operatorname{clip}_{[l,u]}(x)=\min\{u,\max\{l,x\}\}\), set \(\widehat\gamma_N=\operatorname{clip}_{[\underline c_W/2,2\overline c_W]}(\widehat c_W)/\operatorname{clip}_{[\underline c_X/2,2\overline c_X]}(\widehat c_X)\).
body.role: feasible scale ratio with explicit deterministic clipping
